name: Oiram
summary: A platformer, with a large set of levels and an editor.
description:
A side-scrolling platformer built from scratch on Super Mario Advance 4 mechanics, with powerups, secrets and a large set of bundled levels.

[alpha] runs and [2nd] jumps — holding up lets any key jump. Up uses whatever your current powerup gives you: fireballs as Fire Oiram, a tail spin as Racoon Oiram. [del] quits. At the pack loading screen, [mode] switches to an alternate control scheme.

You can build your own levels with the Oiram editor, linked below.

Oiram is not affiliated with Nintendo. The artwork is Nintendo's.
author: Matt "MateoConLechuga" Waltz

uninstall.text: Any levels you made yourself live in their own appvars, which Oiram did not install and this has not touched.
